scope: Three source root causes only; generated artifacts, suppressions, dependencies and concurrent search-palette changes untouched.

rootCauses.name: Background image subtree identity
rootCauses.impact: Ordinary parent updates recreated image DOM nodes and fixed-layout wrappers, restarting image component state. Lower-severity visual/loading reliability risk; live flicker or repeated network transfers were not measured.
rootCauses.fix: Move BgImage and Wrap to module scope; pass content, sectionPosition and backgroundStyle explicitly. Keep source URLs, orientation classes, sizing/position, priority, eager loading and quality rules unchanged.
rootCauses.tests: Three tests failed on DOM identity before the fix and now pass for normal, fixed_cover and fixed_image modes. Both landscape/portrait images and wrapper identity remain stable; position/priority updates still apply.

rootCauses.name: Drawer-toggle active-icon identity
rootCauses.impact: Parent updates unnecessarily remounted the active icon. The custom icon uses visibility/loading state, so remounting can restart that state. Low-severity visual reliability issue, not a demonstrated navigation failure.
rootCauses.fix: Move ActiveIcon to module scope and pass content. Preserve custom/default icon selection, close icon transitions, breakpoint classes, configured button path, right-drawer visibility and toggle handlers.
rootCauses.tests: Left/right identity regressions failed before the fix and now pass; the icon exists before comparison, stays mounted during unrelated updates, and clicks open/close only the selected drawer.

rootCauses.name: Shared JSON fetch HTTP handling
rootCauses.impact: The helper accepted HTTP error JSON as success. Runtime tests demonstrate the failure, but no internal callers were found, so current live-page impact is unestablished and this is defensive hardening.
rootCauses.fix: Reject non-OK responses before consuming JSON. Error includes only HTTP status, not URL or body. Successful JSON, fetch options and network rejection behavior remain unchanged.
rootCauses.tests: Four status regressions (401/404/429/500) failed before the fix. All six helper tests now pass, covering untouched response bodies on errors, successful JSON/options and original network errors.

recipeReview: Fetched each recipe via curl with Cache-Control:no-cache and Pragma:no-cache. Read validation/false-positive predicates. These inner functions return JSX and are rendered as components; failing DOM identity tests confirm real remounts. HTTP Response tests confirm the unchecked-response behavior. Applied module-scope component identities and response.ok guard exactly as prescribed.
grouping: No fixGroupId on selected diagnostics. Duplicate nesting rules grouped by underlying identity repair; the two background-image helpers form one background subtree repair.

validation.tests: 11 passed across 3 files; 9 regression cases failed before the changes
validation.eslint: Zero errors; one no-img-element warning in the intentional next/image test mock. Production files have no lint warnings. No suppression added.
validation.format: Prettier check and git diff --check pass
validation.overallCount: 156 in previous pass to 147 now: seven findings removed by this pass, two removed by concurrent ListSearchAutocompleteContainer changes.
validation.limitations: No production build, live-browser or live-network verification. DOM tests use happy-dom with mocked leaf images/icons; HTTP tests use real Response objects with mocked fetch.

followUp: Unchecked HTTP responses in the client Google Forms proxy and Instagram helpers; usage should be reviewed before prioritizing.
